blocking_focus: Complete the candidate-bound Tester MCP state matrix.

preservation_constraints.requirement: Keep frozen technical baseline `native_godot_project` passing. Do not treat this as a mandate to preserve the same visible asset, map, HUD family, or material choice if a higher-quality replacement is available and the PRD still fits.

Keep frozen technical baseline `host_godot_boot` passing. Do not treat this as a mandate to preserve the same visible asset, map, HUD family, or material choice if a higher-quality replacement is available and the PRD still fits.

task_specification.objective: Restore the Mournlight survivor release shell, make automatic lantern combat audibly and visually causal, and repair authored-cemetery traversal integrity while preserving the bound map and weapon package.

diagnosis.root_cause: The entry shell remains an unrelated FPS menu, the product-owned automatic lantern presentation emits no audible Effects-bus event in fresh capture, and cemetery landmark traversal still lacks stable camera and spatial integrity evidence.

stop_conditions: Stop after the three bounded task families are implemented and their black-box and white-box checks are ready for Tester recapture.
Do not replace the preserved authored cemetery or weapon package or perform destructive asset surgery.

strategy.rationale: Use separate root-cause treatments for product-shell rebinding, automatic combat/audio routing, and map-relative spatial/camera restoration. Include the required choice visual hierarchy in the shell/HUD task and preserve the authored environment and weapon resources.

code: Run native Godot boot/integrity checks and verify no parse or runtime errors in changed scenes and scripts.
White-box inspect entry/run-state bindings, upgrade eligibility and displayed values, lantern audio routing/event ownership, and cemetery spawn/collision/camera bindings.
runtime: Tester recaptures fresh title-to-gameplay, first-run guidance, upgrade draft, pause/result/retry, and clean restart states with runtime state and logs.
Tester runs the audio causality probe: capture Effects and Master, perform one automatic attack window, inspect waveform RMS and source-event timeline, then verify hit/miss and reset behavior.
Tester runs sparse spatial probes at spawn, critical route, central landmark before/near/after traversal, cardinal views, and perimeter; recapture failed occlusion or collision cells first.
Tester verifies keyboard, mouse, and gamepad focus/activation on title, upgrade, pause, result, and retry flows.
visual: Fresh title and gameplay screenshots use Mournlight cemetery-moonlight presentation with readable player, enemies, HUD, and objective cues.
Adjacent attack frames show bounded lantern bolt/impact VFX without duplicated full-recording playback.
Movement screenshots retain stable central landmark visibility, external depth, grounded collision, and coherent perimeter framing.

done_when: Fresh launch presents Mournlight identity and moonlit cemetery presentation rather than the FPS shell.
Play enters an ordinary run with Warden, enemies, HUD, automatic attack, pickups, level-up draft, result, retry, and clean restart/title transitions.

First-run guidance briefly teaches movement, dash, automatic attack, pickup collection, and the first upgrade in the real arena, includes the authored gameplay illustration, is dismissible, and does not reappear on retry.

Replace text-stacked upgrade or weapon choices with authored silhouettes/icons leading each card, compact stat icons, truthful current-to-new values, no more than three decision-relevant stat deltas, no NEW or LOCKED placeholders in CURRENT values, and restrained supporting copy.
Upgrade cards and title/pause/result/retry controls expose visually distinct keyboard, mouse, and gamepad focus and activation states while preserving pause ownership and input context.
tasks.instructions: Rebind the product entry and run shell to the Mournlight survivor experience: title identity, authored cemetery start, authoritative run state, HUD, first-run guidance, upgrade draft, pause/result/retry, and accessible input discovery. Replace text-stacked upgrade or weapon choices with a visual hierarchy led by silhouettes/icons; show compact icons and truthful current-to-new values for no more than three decision-relevant stat deltas, omitting unchanged, exhaustive, or placeholder fields. Preserve native Godot boot and the authored map/weapon resources; edit only candidate-owned shell, lifecycle, and HUD bindings needed for a complete ordinary run.
tasks.title: Restore Mournlight shell, lifecycle, and choice hierarchy

done_when: A single ordinary automatic Warden Lantern attack produces exactly one bounded, recognizable non-silent Effects-bus transient with onset and impact timing aligned to the authoritative attack event.
Concrete hits and misses remain distinguishable through compact impact VFX/feedback; any world-surface impact cue is short and cannot mask the attack report.
Automatic attack remains the sole player-report owner, generic bolt VFX does not replay a complete retained recording, and enemy spatial reports remain separate.
Sustained automatic cadence begins only after valid continuation, stops on release or lifecycle reset, and leaves no stale audio voices after restart.
tasks.instructions: Repair the product-owned Warden Lantern automatic-combat presentation and audio routing around the retained weapon package. Trace attack authorization, bolt presentation, Effects-bus playback, impact feedback, and reset lifecycle; bind a bounded attack cue and isolate attack, miss, concrete-hit, metal-hit, and character-hit stems. If no reliable short surface cue exists, disable only player world-surface impact audio while retaining compact impact VFX and character-hit feedback. Keep preserved weapon hierarchy, transforms, profiles, recoil/timing behavior, and source assets read-only.
tasks.title: Repair automatic lantern causality and audio

done_when: The authored cemetery provides larger traversable scale or an explicit expand treatment, with coherent external world/external depth beyond the playable floor.

Every central building and prominent landmark remains stably visible during ordinary movement/movement replay, with no disappearance or occlusion drift before contact, near contact, or after departure.
Player and enemy collision align with authored streets and structures; the boundary/perimeter prevents pass-through and spawn-outside-map states.

Spawn, objective, navigation, and camera framing are rebased to the intact authored map instance; sparse spawn, critical-route, cardinal, landmark, and perimeter views show stable ground contact and readable threats.
tasks.instructions: Restore the preserved authored cemetery as the sole authoritative environment. Rebase spawn, objective, navigation, collision, and camera framing to native streets/terrain; add only an outer datum plus additive collision/navigation/spawn/objective anchors as needed. Expand to larger traversable scale while retaining native buildings, props, materials, and landmarks. During ordinary movement, verify the central building/landmark has no disappearance or occlusion, the external world retains depth, and the boundary/perimeter prevents pass-through without proxy-floor clutter.
tasks.title: Restore cemetery scale, collision, and landmark visibility
